## Daily goals — 2026-11-17 bounded OL-09 preparation follow-up

Operator-authorized outcome: complete the missing preparation-policy verification for #1476 / OL-09 in #1400 and publish accurate evidence on PR #1514. Preparation only; no implementation, queue admission, primary writes, readiness labels, merge or deployment. Kickstart #1509 and OL-10 are outside this scope.

Selected bounded scope (three existing issues):
- https://github.com/HiQS-Labs/XYZ-forge/issues/1517 — accept the original RAW request; reuse and freshness-check the real medium research receipt and corrected capture; obtain independent preparation QA. No implementation.
- https://github.com/HiQS-Labs/XYZ-forge/issues/1171 — reuse applicable preparation evidence; retain the failed execution history and exhausted 2/2 attempt budget. No rebuild or new attempt.
- https://github.com/HiQS-Labs/XYZ-forge/issues/1518 — preserve the genuine operator decision about full-gate receipt equivalence; no inferred approval or pretend build contract.

Separate follow-up window: 2026-11-17 20:31:12–21:16:12 UTC (45 minutes). The earlier trial ended at 19:50:24 UTC and is not renewed. At most one new read-only research child if necessary; independent preparation QA at most two rounds; at most three repair rounds per blocker, retaining existing counts. Unknown subscription usage stays unknown.

Default selection has no risk-deferral request. A separately recorded hypothetical opt-in walkthrough may test that instruction without changing this real selection. Deeper-research trigger and risk-deferral walkthroughs must be distinguished from live research. Preserve all holds and original evidence. This ledger names existing needed work; it creates no new product task or execution authority.

Acceptance: preparation evidence map, real ledger interpretation, freshness-backed reuse, independent preparation QA, and truthful published results. Award OL-09 only against its unchanged exact criteria; OL-10 and unattended qualification remain separate.
title: Daily goals 2026-11-17: bounded OL-09 preparation verification
